scope: public policy-selection record only; no original market rows, account/fill ledger or private runtime identities

rule.metric: observed complete-leg arithmetic mean net33 descending
rule.reentry_bundle: equal weight for each complete first/additional leg; null and unknown remain disclosed, never zero

selection_boundary: Selection applied only to completed independently reconstructed standalone saved results, before joint outcomes. Source and research-integrity reviewers must confirm it against the private original audits before release.
claim: spent-discovery exploratory selection with missingness, small samples and selection bias; neither selected mean is certified profitable; no prospective edge, physical-share/KRW, fill, investor-return or promotion claim
